instruction: A candid medium shot cinematic still of an outdoor backyard during late afternoon with hanging string lights. On the left, the man in the patterned tee (R3) wears glasses and a peach bandana, laughing heartily while facing right. In the center, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands smiling warmly. On the right, the woman in the crochet vest (R2) wears a colorful headscarf and faces left with a smile. The three friends stand in a circle, playing a hand-stacking game with their hands layered together in the center. The scene is illuminated by warm, soft natural light mixed with glowing overhead bulb lights.
